description: This file defines a PHP class for an ad server plugin called 'No Cookie Image Tag', which generates ad invocation code and manages plugin options within the Revive Adserver platform.

classes.name: Plugins_InvocationTags_OxInvocationTags_adviewnocookies
classes.description: A plugin class for generating ad invocation code without cookies, extending the Plugins_InvocationTags base class.

methods.name: getNameEN
methods.description: Returns the English name of the plugin.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is allowed based on delivery zone and invocation limits.

methods.name: getOptionsList
methods.description: Provides a list of configurable options for the plugin.

methods.name: generateInvocationCode
methods.description: Generates the HTML code for ad invocation with parameters and links.

methods.name: spacer
methods.description: Returns an HTML table row used as a spacer in plugin options UI.
